# Copilot Instructions

Personal academic website of Joshua Chiou: a customized [al-folio](https://github.com/alshedivat/al-folio)
Jekyll fork, deployed to GitHub Pages.

The project documentation is shared with Claude Code, so read these instead of relying on this file:

- [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md): quick reference, build commands, data pipelines, and things not to touch.
- [docs/site-guide.md](../docs/site-guide.md): pages, data files, automation, and recipes for common changes.
- [docs/design.md](../docs/design.md): visual design and accessibility rules.
- [docs/writing-style.md](../docs/writing-style.md): writing rules.

Two rules apply everywhere: American English spelling, and no em dashes in any visible text.

Build check before pushing: `bundle exec jekyll build --strict_front_matter`.
